result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Contractor defends and indemnifies Company and its affiliates for third-party IP claims, breach of law, Contractor-caused data compromise, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, with standard notice, defense control, settlement-consent, and cooperation procedures. It also appropriately avoids imposing a Customer indemnity where none existed. However, exempting the indemnity from Section 7(c)'s bilateral attorneys' fee rule is broader than necessary and could enable recovery of fees in direct indemnity-enforcement litigation; the carve-out should generally be limited to Sections 7(a) and 7(b), while expressly preserving third-party defense costs. Drafting is otherwise professional, although the unchanged main heading remains misleadingly titled “Indemnification of Contractor.”
